description: DiligenceOps: submit an SLA or service terms text. The signed report states the uptime commitment figure and its period, the service-credit terms and bands, the exclusions and the notice requirements with their deadlines, each present or missing and quoted briefly when present, and flags a commitment stated with two figures. POST /api/sla-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-evidence-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the document, recorded in the report.

text.description: The SLA or service terms, up to 256 KB.
